items.title: AI-synthesized faces are indistinguishable from real faces and more trustworthy

judge.evidence_empirical: Our evaluation of the photorealism of AI-synthesized faces indicates that synthesis engines have passed through the uncanny valley and are capable of creating faces that are indistinguishable-and more trustworthy-than real faces.

Para o achado: O resumo afirma que 'synthesis engines... are capable of creating faces that are indistinguishable-and more trustworthy-than real faces', o que sustenta o achado principal.

items.title: Deepfake detection by human crowds, machines, and machine-informed crowds

judge.evidence_topic: In two online studies with 15,016 participants, we present authentic videos and deepfakes and ask participants to identify which is which.
judge.evidence_empirical: In two online studies with 15,016 participants, we present authentic videos and deepfakes and ask participants to identify which is which.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico publicado em periódico (PNAS) que investiga a detecção de deepfakes por humanos, atendendo aos critérios de inclusão. O resumo sustenta os achados extraídos sobre a comparação entre humanos e máquinas e o impacto das previsões do modelo no desempenho humano.

items.title: Fooled twice: People cannot detect deepfakes but think they can

judge.evidence_topic: Research on the human impact of deepfakes, addressing both behaviors in response to and cognitive processing of deepfakes, remains sparse.
judge.evidence_empirical: In a pre-registered behavioral experiment ( N = 210), we show that (a) people cannot reliably detect deepfakes
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico com participantes humanos sobre a percepção de deepfakes, atendendo aos critérios. Os dados extraídos refletem corretamente o método e os achados descritos no resumo.

items.title: Warning: Humans cannot reliably detect speech deepfakes

judge.evidence_topic: We presented genuine and deepfake audio to n = 529 individuals and asked them to identify the deepfakes.
judge.evidence_empirical: We presented genuine and deepfake audio to n = 529 individuals and asked them to identify the deepfakes.

items.title: Training human super-recognizers' detection and discrimination of AI-generated faces

judge.evidence_topic: Here, we investigate synthetic face detection and discrimination in super-recognizers (SRs; who have exceptional face recognition skills), and typical-ability control participants.
judge.evidence_empirical: In two different experimental designs, we found that SRs (total N = 283) were better at detecting and discriminating synthetic faces than controls (total N = 381), where control participants were below chance without training.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico com participantes humanos publicado em periódico revisado por pares, dentro do recorte temporal e temático solicitado. O método e os achados extraídos estão corretamente fundamentados no resumo.

items.title: Voice clones sound realistic but not (yet) hyperrealistic

judge.evidence_topic: We investigated the extent to which AI-generated voices sound real to human listeners, and whether listeners can accurately distinguish between human and AI-generated voices.
judge.evidence_empirical: We tested these questions using AI-generated voices generated with and without a specific human counterpart (i.e., voice clones, and voices generated from the latent space of a large voice model).
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico com participantes humanos sobre a percepção de vozes sintéticas, o que está dentro do escopo. O método descrito condiz com o resumo. O achado principal é sustentado pelo texto do resumo e o tamanho da amostra não é mencionado no resumo, conforme indicado.

items.title: On the realness of people who do not exist: The social processing of artificial faces

judge.evidence_topic: Here, we focus on how people evaluate realistic-looking faces of non-existing people generated by generative adversarial networks (GANs).
judge.evidence_empirical: In three studies, we investigated if and how participants can distinguish between GAN and REAL faces and the social consequences of their exposure to artificial faces.
judge.reason: O artigo investiga a percepção humana de rostos sintéticos (GANs), o que está alinhado ao tema. O estudo é empírico, utilizando três experimentos com participantes humanos. O método e o achado principal estão corretamente descritos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: AI-generated images of familiar faces are indistinguishable from real photographs

judge.evidence_topic: Here, we investigated a new method for generating face images (via ChatGPT plus DALL·E) and its application to both fictional and real (in this case, celebrity) identities. Our results demonstrated that generated images of both fictional (Experiment 1) and celebrity identities (Experiment 2) could not be distinguished from real photographs.
judge.evidence_empirical: Our results demonstrated that generated images of both fictional (Experiment 1) and celebrity identities (Experiment 2) could not be distinguished from real photographs. Further, providing additional real photographs for comparison during the task resulted in limited gains (Experiments 3 and 4).
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico que investiga a percepção humana de imagens sintéticas, alinhando-se ao pedido. O resumo descreve experimentos com participantes humanos, confirmando o método. O achado principal é sustentado pelo texto do resumo.

items.title: Real and Deepfake Face Recognition: An EEG Study on Cognitive and Emotive Implications

judge.evidence_topic: This study investigated healthy individuals' cognitive and emotional engagement in a visual discrimination task involving real and deepfake human faces expressing positive, negative, or neutral emotions.
judge.evidence_empirical: Electroencephalographic (EEG) data were collected from 23 healthy participants using a 21-channel dry-EEG headset; power spectrum and event-related potential (ERP) analyses were performed.
judge.reason: The article is an empirical study using EEG to measure human perception of deepfakes, which fits the criteria. The extracted data accurately reflects the study's methodology and findings.
